registration.method: One uniform scale and translation for the whole image; no local warping
registration.residual_note: No independent pixel-level landmark residual is claimed; visible contour agreement is qualitative.

target_mark_source: User-marked orange resource-window and blue slider regions, represented by the model-coordinate targets used to build the exported 3MF
limitations: The transparent laminate edge is low contrast and the photo has perspective.
The overlay validates visual placement only; it does not prove physical fit or laminate compression clearance.
